subject: Launch gate review & knowledgebase curation plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch gate — outstanding asks & doc owners

Vivek / Marissa —

Quick background: Acme is targeting the region rollout for July 12. Product asked for a short gating decision this week covering: security checklist sign-off, KB readiness for tier-1 flows, and an exceptions list for early customers (they want an agreed way to handle known gaps).

Can we get the following by EOD Thursday?
- Security: final confirmation (SOC evidence bundle) that we can provide to procurement (Ben to own).
- Docs: knowledge base pages for three user journeys (Marissa to confirm owners).
- Exceptions: canonical exceptions log with escalation path (Vivek / Dylan to own).

I’ve attached the initial gating-checklist and a starter KB owners sheet. If we can align on owners + a short rollout rule (canary size, enablement notes) we can sign-off product’s gating criteria.

Thanks,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate — outstanding asks & doc owners

Got it — thanks Laura. Short notes / proposed owners and next steps: 

1) Security evidence: Ben will pull the SOC-2 summary + retention policy. Action: Ben to confirm by Wed 12:00 PT whether additional artifacts are needed for procurement.

2) KB curation: Marissa, please map the three journeys below to specific owners in the sheet. Suggestion: pair each page with a 30-min QA session with Solutions on Thurs.
  - Onboarding + auth flow
  - Dedicated -> Hosted fallback behavior
  - Troubleshooting common inference errors (OOM/quota)

3) Exceptions log: Dylan to create a CSV with columns: exception-id, symptom, workaround, impacted-customers, escalation-owner, roll-back-policy. I’ll maintain a short-runbook (decision tree) for gating exceptions that require leadership escalation.

4) Rollout rule (proposal):
  - Canary = 5 customers or 10% of traffic (whichever smaller) for 72 hours; auto-fallback to previous model on error rate >3% or latency P95 spike >200ms.

If external docs are required for procurement we’ll loop Mira (Acme) to confirm their format. I’ll consolidate and send a single-page decision memo by Thursday 5pm PT.

-Vivek
Engineering Lead, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate — outstanding asks & doc owners

Thanks — I updated the attached kb-curation-owners.xlsx with recommended owners and rough ETA for drafts. Highlights: 
- Onboarding + auth: assigned to Priya (solutions) — draft by Tue 6/22.
- Fallback behavior: assigned to Jonas (runtime) with a 6/24 draft.
- Troubleshooting: assigned to Mina (support) — draft 6/23.

Enablement plan: 30-min walkthrough + 1-pager for customers the day before canary. Can we seed the walkthrough with the short-runbook Vivek mentioned? Also, we need a single canonical link for KB pages (not multiple Drive copies). I propose we publish into the KB space and then share a single canonical Drive link; attaching that link here.

Notes on exceptions: I flagged two early gaps in the spreadsheet where we should consider short-term mitigations (rate-limiting guidance for high QPS customers, and a recommended small-quantization fallback for some edge models). Dylan — can you add severity and suggested mitigations to the exceptions CSV by EOD Wed?

-Marissa
Sr. Technical Writer, Developer Docs
Redwood Inference

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mira Patel <mira@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch gate — outstanding asks & doc owners

Update: I created rollout-exceptions-log.csv (attached) and added severity + suggested mitigations for the two gaps Marissa flagged. Quick summary: 
- Gap #1 (high QPS): Recommend temporary token-based rate-limit and customer-side guidance; severity = P2.
- Gap #2 (edge quantization): Recommend small-quant fallback (optimize config) and monitoring; severity = P3.

Ben confirmed he can assemble the SOC summary; flagged one procurement ask: Acme wants retention window confirmation for logs (they asked for 12 months). Ben — can you confirm retention policy and whether we have any data-location constraints for that window?

Next steps I’ll take: finalize CSV, add impacted-customer column, and post canonical Drive link to the KB folder. Vivek — if you can send the single-page decision memo after you consolidate, we can share with Acme and close the gate.

-Dylan
Staff Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
